### Apportioning the Restored Land
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/apportioning-restored-land
Passage: Ezekiel 47:13-23
Points:
- The promise of renewed land possession assured ancient exiles of their restoration to God's favor and peace.
- The boundary allotments confirm the enduring certainty of the Lord's covenant promises to His people across generations.
- Ezekiel's vision radically includes resident foreigners, granting them an equal inheritance alongside native Israelites.
- New covenant believers are full citizens of God's household with equal access to the King regardless of origin or background.
